blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解物料進入 Grade A/B 無菌區的標準程序，包括 RTP、多層包裝脫除與 VHP 通道的應用場景
blocks.en: Understand the standard procedures for bringing materials into Grade A/B aseptic areas, including the use cases for RTP, multi-layer wrapper removal and VHP pass-throughs

blocks.zh: 掌握滅菌材料保存期限（Sterile Hold Time）的科學依據——關鍵在「屏障完整性」而非時間本身
blocks.en: Master the scientific basis of Sterile Hold Time for sterilized materials: the key is barrier integrity, not time itself

blocks.en: Build a complete picture of the disinfection program: when is rotation of disinfectants needed? What is the role of the sporicide? How does EM data drive program adjustments?

blocks.zh: 了解為何 Grade A/B 使用的消毒劑本身必須是無菌的，以及 0.2 µm 過濾滅菌的標準做法
blocks.en: Understand why disinfectants used in Grade A/B must themselves be sterile, and the standard practice of 0.2 µm filter sterilization

blocks.zh: 熟悉蒸氣滅菌重新確效（Requalification）的頻率要求與 EN 285 / ISO 17665-1 的法規定位
blocks.en: Become familiar with the requalification frequency for steam sterilization and the regulatory standing of EN 285 / ISO 17665-1

blocks.zh: 掌握凍乾機（Lyophilizer）洩漏確效（Leak Qualification）的測試方法、接受標準及 EU Annex 1 2022 要求
blocks.en: Master the test methods, acceptance criteria and EU Annex 1 2022 requirements for lyophilizer leak qualification

blocks.zh: § V. Material Transfer — 物料傳遞
blocks.en: § V. Material Transfer

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：物料進場的三大方式
blocks.en: Key Concept: Three Ways to Bring Materials In

blocks.zh: 單向滅菌通道 (Unidirectional Sterilization Process)：最理想的方式。雙門高壓滅菌釜（Double-door Autoclave）或去熱原隧道（Depyrogenation Tunnel）將滅菌區與無菌區直接連通，物料「進去就是無菌的」，無需穿越暴露環境。
blocks.en: Unidirectional Sterilization Process: The ideal approach. A double-door autoclave or depyrogenation tunnel connects the sterilization area directly to the aseptic area, so materials "are sterile the moment they come in" and never cross an exposed environment.

blocks.zh: 多層包裝脫層法 (Sequential Wrapper Removal)：每進入一個更高級別的區域，就剝去一層外包裝——Grade C→B 脫第一層，Grade B→A 脫第二層。每一層都是一道屏障，也代表一次消毒機會。
blocks.en: Sequential Wrapper Removal: One layer of outer wrapping is removed at each step up to a higher-grade area: the first layer at Grade C to B, the second at Grade B to A. Each layer is a barrier and also an opportunity to disinfect.

blocks.zh: 快速傳遞口 (RTP, Rapid Transfer Port)：隔離器（Isolator）與 RABS 常用的技術，採用 alpha/beta 法蘭系統，在不破壞無菌環境的前提下傳遞物料。EU Annex 1 2022 鼓勵使用。
blocks.en: Rapid Transfer Port (RTP): A technology commonly used with isolators and RABS. It uses an alpha/beta flange system to transfer materials without breaking the aseptic environment. EU Annex 1 2022 encourages its use.

blocks.zh: 比喻：手術室的刷手流程
blocks.en: Analogy: The Surgical Scrub Routine

blocks.zh: 這就像外科醫師進手術室的程序：換鞋進更衣室→刷手消毒→穿無菌手術衣。每一步都有對應的「脫去一層汙染屏障」的動作。Grade C→B→A 的多層包裝脫除，正是同樣的邏輯——用空間梯度來替代時間梯度，確保每一步驟都在受控條件下完成。
blocks.en: It is like a surgeon's routine for entering the operating theatre: change shoes and enter the changing room, scrub and disinfect, then put on the sterile surgical gown. Each step removes a layer of contamination barrier. Removing wrappers in sequence from Grade C to B to A follows the same logic: use a spatial gradient in place of a time gradient, so that every step is completed under controlled conditions.

blocks.zh: RTP 則像「手套箱傳遞窗」——外面的手不能進來，但物品可以安全通過。
blocks.en: An RTP is like a "glove-box pass-through window": hands from outside cannot come in, but items can pass through safely.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「核准清單」是查核重點
blocks.en: Key Note: The "Approved List" Is an Inspection Focus

blocks.zh: 稽查人員特別注意：只有「核准清單」上的物品才能進入 Grade A/B 氣鎖。清單之外的物品必須走偏差程序，並由 QA 與微生物學人員共同制定特定的消毒與監測方案。這一要求表示，CDMO 必須維護一份即時更新的「核准物料清單」，且清單變更需有版本控管。
blocks.en: Auditors pay particular attention to this: only items on the "approved list" may enter the Grade A/B airlock. Items not on the list must go through the deviation procedure, and QA and microbiology personnel jointly define a specific disinfection and monitoring plan. This means a CDMO must maintain an up-to-date "approved materials list", with version control for any change to the list.

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 2022 Section 4.26–4.30 對物料傳遞有詳細要求，特別強調 VHP（氣化過氧化氫）去汙對進入隔離器的物料的重要性。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 2022 Sections 4.26-4.30 contain detailed requirements for material transfer, and particularly emphasize the importance of VHP (vaporized hydrogen peroxide) decontamination for materials entering isolators.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 物料管理 SOP 設計
blocks.en: Practical Application: Designing a CDMO Material Management SOP

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，每個客戶產品可能用到不同的耗材與設備。建議在物料管理 SOP 中明確：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, each client's product may use different consumables and equipment. The material management SOP should clearly define the following:

blocks.zh: 核准物料清單（附核准消毒方法）
blocks.en: An approved materials list (with the approved disinfection method)

blocks.zh: 非常規物料的偏差觸發條件與快速審批流程
blocks.en: Deviation trigger conditions and a fast approval process for non-routine materials

blocks.zh: 包裝完整性目視檢查的培訓記錄要求
blocks.en: Training record requirements for visual inspection of package integrity

blocks.zh: 電子儀器（無法高壓滅菌）的驗證消毒替代方案（如酒精擦拭程序確效）
blocks.en: Validated disinfection alternatives for electronic instruments that cannot be autoclaved (for example, a validated alcohol wipe-down procedure)

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某電子秤需要進入 Grade B 區進行填充重量校正，但它無法高壓滅菌。依據 PDA PtC-1 建議，應採取什麼措施才合規？
blocks.en: An electronic balance must enter the Grade B area for fill-weight calibration, but it cannot be autoclaved. According to PDA PtC-1 recommendations, what must be done to be compliant?

blocks.zh: 雙層包裝的元件從 Grade C 傳遞到 Grade B 時，應在哪個節點脫去外包裝？是進入 Grade C 前、進入 Grade B 氣鎖時，還是進入 Grade B 後？
blocks.en: When a double-wrapped component is transferred from Grade C to Grade B, at which point should the outer wrapper be removed: before entering Grade C, at the Grade B airlock, or after entering Grade B?

blocks.zh: RTP 技術的核心優勢是什麼？與傳統氣鎖比較，在汙染控制上有何不同？
blocks.en: What is the core advantage of RTP technology? How does it differ in contamination control compared with a traditional airlock?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：無菌保存期的真正決定因素
blocks.en: Key Concept: What Really Determines Sterile Hold Time

blocks.zh: 這是 PDA PtC-1 最具洞察力的觀點之一：「已滅菌材料只要屏障（Barrier）完整，理論上可以永久保持無菌。」
blocks.en: This is one of the most insightful points in PDA PtC-1: "As long as the barrier remains intact, sterilized material can in theory remain sterile indefinitely."

blocks.zh: 關鍵不是「時間流逝」，而是「屏障是否被破壞」。影響屏障完整性的因素：
blocks.en: The key is not "the passage of time" but "whether the barrier has been breached". Factors that affect barrier integrity:

blocks.zh: 搬運方式：撞擊、穿刺、摩擦
blocks.en: Handling: impact, puncture, abrasion

blocks.zh: 儲存條件：溫濕度、光照、堆疊壓力
blocks.en: Storage conditions: temperature and humidity, light, stacking pressure

blocks.zh: 包裝材質老化：長時間後可能降解（這才是設定最大保存期限的原因）
blocks.en: Aging of packaging material: it may degrade over a long period (this is the reason for setting a maximum hold time)

blocks.zh: 因此，目視檢查（Visual Inspection）是每次使用前最重要的控制點，而非依賴有效期標籤。
blocks.en: Therefore, visual inspection before each use is the most important control point, rather than reliance on an expiry label.

blocks.zh: 比喻：真空保鮮袋的道理
blocks.en: Analogy: How a Vacuum Food Bag Works

blocks.zh: 把食物放入真空保鮮袋密封——只要袋子沒有破損，食物就受到保護。保存「時間」當然有其意義（材料會老化），但真正的風險是「袋子被戳破」。無菌包裝的邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: Put food in a vacuum bag and seal it: as long as the bag is not damaged, the food is protected. Storage "time" certainly matters (materials age), but the real risk is "the bag being punctured". Sterile packaging follows exactly the same logic.

blocks.zh: RTP 罐的通氣過濾器（Vent Filter）就像壓力鍋的洩壓閥——高壓滅菌時必須讓蒸氣進出，但又要確保通道不成為汙染入口，所以高壓滅菌後必須做過濾器完整性測試（Post-use Integrity Test）。
blocks.en: The vent filter on an RTP canister is like the pressure release valve on a pressure cooker: during autoclaving, steam must be able to go in and out, but the pathway must not become an entry point for contamination, so a post-use integrity test of the filter must be done after autoclaving.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：APS 在保存期確效中的角色
blocks.en: Key Note: The Role of APS in Hold-Time Validation

blocks.zh: PDA 建議用一次 APS（無菌製程模擬，Media Fill）來支持最大保存期限的確效——前提是在 APS 中使用已達最大保存期限的包裝物料。
blocks.en: PDA recommends using one APS (aseptic process simulation, media fill) to support validation of the maximum hold time, provided that packaging materials that have reached the maximum hold time are used in the APS.

blocks.zh: 這與熱封（Heat-seal）確效相輔相成：熱封工藝確效確保密封強度，APS 則確認在模擬最惡劣使用條件下（達最大保存期限＋實際操作搬運）包裝仍能維持無菌屏障。
blocks.en: This complements heat-seal validation: heat-seal process validation ensures seal strength, while the APS confirms that the packaging still maintains the sterile barrier under the worst-case conditions of use (reaching the maximum hold time plus actual handling during operations).

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 2022 Section 8.123 要求對滅菌後包裝完整性進行確效，並在 APS 中使用達最長保存期限的物料。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 2022 Section 8.123 requires validation of package integrity after sterilization, and the use of materials at the maximum hold time in the APS.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 物料保存期管理
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Material Hold-Time Management

blocks.zh: CDMO 同時運行多個客戶項目，物料保存期管理容易出現混亂。建議：
blocks.en: A CDMO runs several client projects at the same time, so material hold-time management easily becomes confused. Recommendations:

blocks.zh: 建立物料保存期矩陣，依包裝方式（折疊＋膠帶 vs 熱封預製袋）、儲存環境（Grade B vs Grade C）分別設定最大期限
blocks.en: Build a material hold-time matrix that sets the maximum period separately by packaging method (folded + tape vs. heat-sealed pre-formed pouch) and storage environment (Grade B vs. Grade C)

blocks.zh: 每批次使用前強制執行目視檢查並記錄，作為批次記錄的一部分
blocks.en: Enforce and record visual inspection before every batch use, as part of the batch record

blocks.zh: RTP 罐使用後必須立即記錄通氣過濾器完整性測試結果，失敗即觸發偏差
blocks.en: Record the vent filter integrity test result immediately after each use of an RTP canister; a failure triggers a deviation

blocks.zh: 如果一批滅菌包裝元件在 Grade B 室溫下已存放 14 個月，超過公司規定的 12 個月最大保存期限，但目視檢查包裝完整無損——根據 PtC-1 原則，您如何評估其使用的可接受性？
blocks.en: A batch of sterilized packaged components has been stored for 14 months at room temperature in Grade B, exceeding the company's 12-month maximum hold time, but visual inspection shows the packaging intact and undamaged. Under PtC-1 principles, how would you assess whether it is acceptable to use?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「RTP 罐高壓滅菌後必須做通氣過濾器完整性測試」？如果跳過此步驟，可能的 GMP 後果是什麼？
blocks.en: Why must an RTP canister have a vent filter integrity test after autoclaving? If this step is skipped, what are the possible GMP consequences?

blocks.zh: § VI. Cleaning, Disinfection, and Sterilization — 清潔、消毒與滅菌
blocks.en: § VI. Cleaning, Disinfection, and Sterilization

blocks.zh: 核心概念：消毒程序設計的四個關鍵要素
blocks.en: Key Concept: Four Key Elements of Disinfection Program Design

blocks.zh: 1. 消毒劑種類（Biocide Types）：
blocks.en: 1. Biocide types:

blocks.zh: 季銨鹽（QAC）— 廣效，對細菌繁殖體有效，不殺孢子
blocks.en: Quaternary ammonium compounds (QAC) - broad spectrum, effective against vegetative bacteria, not sporicidal

blocks.zh: 酒精類（Isopropanol/Ethanol）— 快速，對細菌繁殖體有效，不殺孢子
blocks.en: Alcohols (isopropanol/ethanol) - fast acting, effective against vegetative bacteria, not sporicidal

blocks.zh: 次氯酸鈉（Sodium Hypochlorite）— 殺孢子，但腐蝕性高
blocks.en: Sodium hypochlorite - sporicidal, but highly corrosive

blocks.zh: 過氧化氫（H₂O₂）— 殺孢子，液態或氣態（VHP）皆可
blocks.en: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) - sporicidal, in liquid or vapor (VHP) form

blocks.zh: 過氧乙酸（Peracetic Acid）— 殺孢子，廣效
blocks.en: Peracetic acid - sporicidal, broad spectrum

blocks.zh: 2. 輪替策略（Rotation Strategy）：不強制輪替，但使用多種消毒劑（包括定期使用殺孢子劑）是最佳實務。
blocks.en: 2. Rotation strategy: Rotation is not mandatory, but using several disinfectants (including a periodic sporicide) is best practice.

blocks.zh: 3. 頻率由 EM 數據驅動：環境監測（EM）趨勢決定計畫的調整，而不是固定公式。
blocks.en: 3. Frequency is driven by EM data: Environmental monitoring (EM) trends determine program adjustments, not a fixed formula.

blocks.zh: 4. 隔離器必須用氣態/霧化殺孢子劑（VHP/H₂O₂）：液態消毒無法穿透複雜幾何空間。
blocks.en: 4. Isolators must use a gaseous/aerosolized sporicide (VHP/H₂O₂): Liquid disinfection cannot penetrate complex geometries.

blocks.zh: 比喻：抗生素輪替原則（抗藥性管理）
blocks.en: Analogy: The Antibiotic Rotation Principle (Resistance Management)

blocks.zh: PDA 特別指出「尚未有科學證據證明微生物會對消毒劑產生抵抗性」——但這不代表可以只用一種。就像醫院的感染管控：不是怕微生物「學壞」，而是確保廣譜殺滅。
blocks.en: PDA specifically notes that "there is as yet no scientific evidence that microorganisms develop resistance to disinfectants", but this does not mean a single agent is enough. As with hospital infection control: the concern is not that microorganisms "go bad", but ensuring broad-spectrum kill.

blocks.zh: 只用殺孢子劑的比喻：就像餐廳只用最強的洗碗精——短期很有效，但長期會腐蝕餐具和水槽。消毒劑的選擇必須平衡微生物效力與材料相容性。
blocks.en: An analogy for using only a sporicide: it is like a restaurant using only the strongest dish detergent. It is very effective in the short term, but over time it corrodes the dishes and the sink. The choice of disinfectant must balance antimicrobial efficacy against material compatibility.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Grade A vs Grade B 的差異化要求
blocks.en: Key Note: Differentiated Requirements for Grade A vs. Grade B

blocks.zh: Grade A 區域（充填區）：建議使用單次用量（Single-use）的無菌消毒劑包裝，避免噴瓶回吸汙染。
blocks.en: Grade A area (filling zone): single-use sterile disinfectant packaging is recommended, to avoid suck-back contamination from spray bottles.

blocks.zh: Grade B 區（背景環境）：可使用可重複使用噴瓶，但噴瓶本身必須能重新滅菌，且有防止回吸汙染的設計。
blocks.en: Grade B area (background environment): reusable spray bottles may be used, but the bottle itself must be re-sterilizable and designed to prevent suck-back contamination.

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 2022 Section 4.36 明確要求：Grade A/B 使用的消毒劑必須是無菌的，並需定期評估消毒程序的有效性，特別是對孢子形成菌（Sporicide）的殺滅能力。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 2022 Section 4.36 explicitly requires: disinfectants used in Grade A/B must be sterile, and the effectiveness of the disinfection program must be assessed periodically, especially its ability to kill spore-forming organisms (sporicidal efficacy).

blocks.zh: 稽查重點：殺孢子劑的使用頻率和濃度是否有文件支持？接觸時間（Contact Time）是否確效？
blocks.en: Audit focus: Is the frequency and concentration of sporicide use supported by documentation? Has the contact time been validated?

blocks.zh: 實務應用：消毒程序驗證文件要求
blocks.en: Practical Application: Documentation Requirements for Disinfection Program Validation

blocks.zh: 一份符合 GMP 的消毒程序必須包含：
blocks.en: A GMP-compliant disinfection program must include:

blocks.zh: 消毒劑選擇的科學依據（efficacy data，含殺孢子劑效力數據）
blocks.en: Scientific rationale for disinfectant selection (efficacy data, including sporicidal efficacy data)

blocks.zh: 使用頻率矩陣（Grade A/B 分開說明）
blocks.en: A use-frequency matrix (Grade A and B described separately)

blocks.zh: 接觸時間（Contact Time）規格與確效數據
blocks.en: Contact time specifications and validation data

blocks.zh: 消毒劑稀釋程序及保存期限
blocks.en: Disinfectant dilution procedures and hold times

blocks.zh: EM 趨勢審查週期與計畫調整觸發條件
blocks.en: EM trend review cycle and triggers for program adjustment

blocks.zh: 腐蝕性風險評估（設備材質相容性報告）
blocks.en: Corrosion risk assessment (equipment material compatibility report)

blocks.zh: 某廠每日使用 70% IPA 擦拭 Grade B，每月用一次次氯酸鈉。稽查員問：「你的殺孢子劑使用頻率是基於什麼依據？」您如何回答才能符合 PtC-1 的建議？
blocks.en: A site wipes Grade B daily with 70% IPA and uses sodium hypochlorite once a month. The auditor asks: "On what basis did you set the frequency of sporicide use?" How would you answer in a way that is consistent with PtC-1's recommendations?

blocks.zh: 如果 EM 數據顯示近三個月 Grade B 環境出現 Bacillus spp.（孢子形成菌）趨勢，消毒程序應如何調整？需要哪些文件支持這個調整？
blocks.en: If EM data show a Bacillus spp. (spore-former) trend in the Grade B environment over the past three months, how should the disinfection program be adjusted? What documentation is needed to support the adjustment?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為什麼消毒劑本身也需要無菌？
blocks.en: Key Concept: Why Must the Disinfectant Itself Be Sterile?

blocks.zh: 這個問題初聽起來像個謎語——「用來殺菌的東西，自己也有菌？」
blocks.en: At first this sounds like a riddle: "the thing used to kill microbes has microbes itself?"

blocks.zh: 答案是：是的，可能有。 許多消毒劑（如 QAC、酒精）對細菌繁殖體有效，但不殺孢子。如果消毒劑本身含有孢子，你不僅沒有去汙，反而把孢子帶進了最乾淨的地方。
blocks.en: The answer is: yes, it can. Many disinfectants (such as QAC and alcohol) are effective against vegetative bacteria but do not kill spores. If the disinfectant itself contains spores, you have not decontaminated anything; you have carried spores into the cleanest place.

blocks.zh: Grade A/B 強制無菌的原因：這兩個等級直接與開放的無菌產品接觸，任何汙染都是不可接受的。
blocks.en: The reason sterility is mandatory for Grade A/B: these two grades come into direct contact with open sterile product, and any contamination is unacceptable.

blocks.zh: 殺孢子劑例外：PDA 接受殺孢子劑（如次氯酸鈉、VHP）本身具有「自我滅菌」特性，通常不需要另行滅菌——但需有科學依據。
blocks.en: The sporicide exception: PDA accepts that sporicides (such as sodium hypochlorite and VHP) have "self-sterilizing" properties and usually need no separate sterilization, but there must be a scientific rationale.

blocks.zh: 比喻：用骯髒的抹布擦桌子
blocks.en: Analogy: Wiping a Table with a Dirty Rag

blocks.zh: 想像你用一塊含有細菌孢子的「消毒抹布」去擦手術台——你以為在消毒，實際上在播種汙染。
blocks.en: Imagine wiping the operating table with a "disinfectant rag" that contains bacterial spores. You think you are disinfecting, but you are actually seeding contamination.

blocks.zh: 0.2 µm 過濾滅菌就像「先把抹布高壓消毒，再用來擦」。這一步看似多餘，但在 Grade A/B 環境中是無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）的基礎。
blocks.en: 0.2 µm filter sterilization is like "autoclaving the rag first, then using it to wipe". The step may look redundant, but in Grade A/B environments it is the foundation of sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：購買成品消毒劑 vs 自製稀釋
blocks.en: Key Note: Purchasing Finished Disinfectant vs. Preparing Your Own Dilution

blocks.zh: 購買即用型（Ready-to-Use）無菌消毒劑：
blocks.en: Purchased ready-to-use sterile disinfectant:

blocks.zh: 不需要做無菌測試（Sterility Test）——供應商稽核＋CoA 即可
blocks.en: No sterility test is needed: supplier audit + CoA is sufficient

blocks.zh: 若對供應商信心不足，可做「skip lot」確認測試
blocks.en: If confidence in the supplier is low, a "skip lot" confirmation test can be done

blocks.zh: 自製稀釋消毒劑：
blocks.en: In-house diluted disinfectant:

blocks.zh: 必須用 0.2 µm（或更小孔徑）過濾滅菌
blocks.en: Must be filter-sterilized through 0.2 µm (or smaller pore size)

blocks.zh: 儲存在滅菌過的密閉容器中
blocks.en: Stored in sterilized, closed containers

blocks.zh: 過濾到使用的時間間隔，以及使用中的保存期限，都必須確效
blocks.en: The time from filtration to use, and the in-use hold time, must be validated

blocks.zh: 必須定期做微生物監測
blocks.en: Must be microbiologically monitored periodically

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 2022 Section 4.36：明確要求 Grade A/B 消毒劑必須無菌，且存放期限須確效。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 2022 Section 4.36: explicitly requires disinfectants used in Grade A/B to be sterile, with the hold time validated.

blocks.zh: 廠內自製 70% IPA（用注射用水稀釋藥用級乙醇），用 0.2 µm 過濾後裝入高壓滅菌的 HDPE 噴瓶，存放 Grade B 備用。需要確效哪些項目才符合 PDA PtC-1 要求？
blocks.en: A site prepares 70% IPA in-house (diluting pharmaceutical-grade ethanol with water for injection), filters it through 0.2 µm into autoclaved HDPE spray bottles, and stores them in Grade B for use. What needs to be validated to meet PDA PtC-1 requirements?

blocks.zh: 購買一款「Sterile Sporicide」（無菌殺孢子劑），廠商附有 CoA 及無菌保證書。是否還需要做無菌測試？根據 PtC-1 如何判斷？
blocks.en: A site buys a "Sterile Sporicide" and the vendor supplies a CoA and a sterility assurance certificate. Is a sterility test still needed? How do you decide under PtC-1?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Topic B vs Topic C 的微妙差異
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Subtle Difference Between Topic B and Topic C

blocks.zh: Topic B（Section V-B）談的是「進入無菌區後的物料保存期」，Topic C 談的是「滅菌包裝部件的保存期確效方法」——兩者本質相同，但 Topic C 更聚焦在如何確效。
blocks.en: Topic B (Section V-B) addresses "the hold time of materials after they enter the aseptic area", while Topic C addresses "how to validate the hold time of sterilized packaged components". The two are essentially the same, but Topic C focuses more on how to validate.

blocks.zh: 三個確效基礎：
blocks.en: Three bases for validation:

blocks.zh: 屏障特性：包材的 MVTR（水蒸氣透過率）、孔隙度測試
blocks.en: Barrier properties: MVTR (moisture vapor transmission rate) and porosity testing of the packaging material

blocks.zh: 操作程序：折疊/熱封工藝確效，搬運 SOP
blocks.en: Operating procedures: folding/heat-seal process validation, handling SOPs

blocks.zh: 儲存環境品質：Grade C 儲存 vs 受控一般室溫
blocks.en: Quality of the storage environment: Grade C storage vs. controlled ambient room temperature

blocks.zh: PDA 的立場：熱封預製袋優於折疊+膠帶——因為熱封可以量化確效（剝離強度測試），而折疊主要依賴人員操作一致性。
blocks.en: PDA's position: heat-sealed pre-formed pouches are preferred over folding + tape, because heat sealing can be validated quantitatively (peel strength testing), whereas folding relies mainly on consistency of personnel technique.

blocks.zh: 比喻：保鮮膜 vs 真空密封袋
blocks.en: Analogy: Cling Film vs. Vacuum-Seal Bags

blocks.zh: 折疊包裝就像用保鮮膜包食物——技術依賴人，結果難以標準化。熱封預製袋就像真空密封機——有數據支持（密封溫度、壓力、時間），品質可重複，可量化確效。
blocks.en: Folded packaging is like wrapping food in cling film: the technique depends on the person and the result is hard to standardize. A heat-sealed pre-formed pouch is like a vacuum sealing machine: it is backed by data (sealing temperature, pressure, time), the quality is repeatable, and it can be validated quantitatively.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 PDA 說「優先選擇預製密封包裝」——不是技術迷信，而是可確效性更強。
blocks.en: This is why PDA says "prefer pre-formed sealed packaging". It is not technology worship; it is because it is more readily validated.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Media Fill 的角色與限制
blocks.en: Key Note: The Role and Limits of Media Fill

blocks.zh: Media Fill（無菌製程模擬，APS）可作為包裝保存期確效的「額外步驟」，但 PDA 明確說：Media Fill 單獨不足以，也不一定必要，來確效保存期限。
blocks.en: Media fill (aseptic process simulation, APS) can serve as an "additional step" in validating packaging hold time, but PDA states clearly: a media fill alone is neither sufficient, nor necessarily required, to validate hold time.

blocks.zh: 原因：Media Fill 評估的是整體無菌製程，而非單獨的包裝屏障能力。包裝確效應以物理/化學方法（ISO 11607-1：破壞性測試、染料滲透、氦氣洩漏）為主，Media Fill 為輔。
blocks.en: Reason: A media fill evaluates the overall aseptic process, not the barrier capability of the packaging on its own. Packaging validation should rely mainly on physical/chemical methods (ISO 11607-1: destructive testing, dye penetration, helium leak), with the media fill as support.

blocks.zh: 一旦確效完成，若無包材或滅菌工藝的變更，不需要定期重新確效保存期限——這降低了維護成本。
blocks.en: Once validation is complete, if there is no change to the packaging material or the sterilization process, periodic revalidation of the hold time is not required, which lowers maintenance cost.

blocks.zh: 廠內計劃將填充針頭（stainless steel needles）的包裝從「折疊 Tyvek + 膠帶」改為「Tyvek/PE 預製熱封袋」。需要做哪些確效工作才能支持新的最大保存期限？
blocks.en: A site plans to change the packaging of its filling needles (stainless steel needles) from "folded Tyvek + tape" to "Tyvek/PE pre-formed heat-sealed pouches". What validation work is needed to support the new maximum hold time?

blocks.zh: 保存期確效的「屏障特性」測試通常包括哪些方法？請舉出至少三種測試手段（可參考 ISO 11607-1）。
blocks.en: What methods are typically included in "barrier property" testing for hold-time validation? List at least three test methods (ISO 11607-1 may be consulted).

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「每12個月」重新確效的法規依據
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Regulatory Basis for "Every 12 Months" Requalification

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-1 推薦每 12 個月進行一次定期重新確效（Periodic Requalification）——這是業界共識，也與多個監管機構的期望一致。重新確效的三個觸發條件：
blocks.en: PDA PtC-1 recommends periodic requalification every 12 months. This is an industry consensus and is also consistent with the expectations of several regulators. The three triggers for requalification:

blocks.zh: 設備或製程變更（Change-triggered）：任何可能影響確效狀態的變更都需評估是否重新確效
blocks.en: Equipment or process change (change-triggered): any change that may affect the validated state must be assessed for requalification

blocks.zh: 定期計畫（Scheduled，通常每年）：即使沒有變更，也要確認「靜悄悄的漂移（Drift）」
blocks.en: Scheduled (usually annual): even without changes, it is necessary to confirm there is no "silent drift"

blocks.zh: 偏差或績效下降（Event-triggered）：如 BI 失效、儀器漂移
blocks.en: Deviation or performance decline (event-triggered): such as BI failure or instrument drift

blocks.zh: 等效性（Equivalence）建立後，多台同型滅菌器可以減少重新確效頻率——但需有文件支持等效性的科學基礎。
blocks.en: Once equivalence is established, the requalification frequency for several sterilizers of the same type can be reduced, but the scientific basis for equivalence must be documented.

blocks.zh: 比喻：汽車年度定期保養
blocks.en: Analogy: Annual Car Servicing

blocks.zh: 即使您的車「感覺開起來沒問題」，每年還是要做定期保養——檢查剎車片磨損、機油老化、輪胎氣壓。滅菌製程的年度重新確效正是同樣的邏輯：不是因為「已知有問題」，而是要確認「沒有未知的問題」。
blocks.en: Even if your car "feels fine to drive", it still needs its annual service: checking brake pad wear, oil aging and tire pressure. Annual requalification of a sterilization process follows the same logic: not because "a problem is known", but to confirm that "there are no unknown problems".

blocks.zh: 「漂移（Drift）」就像慢慢消耗的剎車片——沒有明顯故障，但長期下來會失效。年度確效就是要抓到這種緩慢的偏移。
blocks.en: "Drift" is like brake pads slowly wearing down: there is no obvious failure, but over time they will fail. Annual qualification is meant to catch this kind of slow shift.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：EU vs FDA 對重新確效頻率的立場差異
blocks.en: Key Note: EU vs. FDA Positions on Requalification Frequency

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 2022：Section 8.48 明確要求蒸氣滅菌製程定期重新確效，並要求在重新確效中包含蒸氣品質驗證（乾燥飽和度、不凝結氣體、過熱蒸氣測試）。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 2022: Section 8.48 explicitly requires periodic requalification of steam sterilization processes, and requires that requalification include steam quality verification (dryness fraction, non-condensable gases, superheat tests).

blocks.zh: FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004)：強調基於績效的方法（Performance-based），每年回顧製程數據，必要時進行重新確效。FDA 沒有強制規定「12個月」，但 12 個月已成為業界預設標準。
blocks.en: FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004): emphasizes a performance-based approach, with annual review of process data and requalification where necessary. FDA does not mandate "12 months", but 12 months has become the default industry standard.

blocks.zh: PDA TR1 (Revised 2007)：最詳細的蒸氣滅菌確效指南，是本 Topic 的技術基礎文件。CDMO 在設計重新確效計畫時應同時參考 PDA TR1 和 EU Annex 1 2022。
blocks.en: PDA TR1 (Revised 2007): the most detailed guide to steam sterilization validation and the technical foundation document for this Topic. When designing a requalification program, a CDMO should refer to both PDA TR1 and EU Annex 1 2022.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：年度重新確效計畫的文件架構
blocks.en: Practical Application: Document Structure of the Annual Requalification Program

blocks.zh: 一份完整的年度重新確效計畫應包含：
blocks.en: A complete annual requalification program should include:

blocks.zh: 所有受影響滅菌負載（Loads）的清單
blocks.en: A list of all affected sterilization loads

blocks.zh: 變更控制文件回顧記錄
blocks.en: Records of the change control document review

blocks.zh: 前一年度 BI 數據、熱分佈數據趨勢分析
blocks.en: Trend analysis of the previous year's BI data and heat distribution data

blocks.zh: 維護與校正記錄回顧
blocks.en: Review of maintenance and calibration records

blocks.zh: 蒸氣品質測試（若涉及多孔/硬質物品）
blocks.en: Steam quality tests (where porous/hard goods are involved)

blocks.zh: 重新確效執行記錄與結論報告
blocks.en: Requalification execution records and a conclusion report

blocks.zh: 廠內有三台同型號高壓滅菌器（同廠商、同年份、同規格），已建立等效性。可以如何設計重新確效計畫以減少工作量，同時仍符合 PtC-1 的要求？
blocks.en: A site has three autoclaves of the same model (same manufacturer, same year, same specification) with equivalence established. How can the requalification program be designed to reduce workload while still meeting PtC-1 requirements?

blocks.zh: 年度重新確效時發現某負載的 F₀ 值比原始確效低了 15%，但仍超過接受標準。是否需要採取措施？根據「製程績效和控制」原則，您會建議什麼行動？
blocks.en: During annual requalification, the F₀ value of one load is found to be 15% lower than in the original validation, but still above the acceptance criterion. Is action needed? Based on the "process performance and control" principle, what action would you recommend?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：裝載模式確效的三個關鍵參數
blocks.en: Key Concept: Three Key Parameters for Load Pattern Validation

blocks.zh: 多孔/硬質物品（Porous/Hard Goods）蒸氣滅菌的挑戰遠比液體滅菌複雜，因為蒸氣必須穿透物理屏障。三個關鍵因素：
blocks.en: Steam sterilization of porous/hard goods is far more complex than sterilization of liquids, because steam must penetrate physical barriers. Three key factors:

blocks.zh: 空氣排除（Air Removal）：殘留空氣會阻礙蒸氣接觸，是最大的失效風險。Bowie-Dick 測試就是用來驗證空氣排除效果。
blocks.en: Air removal: Residual air obstructs steam contact and is the biggest failure risk. The Bowie-Dick test is used to verify the effectiveness of air removal.

blocks.zh: 蒸氣穿透（Steam Penetration）：蒸氣必須到達物品的最難穿透點（Cold Spot），通常用生物指示劑（BI）放在此處。
blocks.en: Steam penetration: Steam must reach the item's hardest-to-penetrate point (cold spot), where a biological indicator (BI) is usually placed.

blocks.zh: 冷凝液排除（Condensate Removal）：積水會阻礙後續蒸氣接觸，也影響乾燥。
blocks.en: Condensate removal: Pooled water obstructs subsequent steam contact and also affects drying.

blocks.zh: 最小-最大括弧法（Bracketing）：確效最重（最多物品）和最輕（最少物品）的裝載——若兩端都通過，中間的裝載也被接受。前提是有數據支持「中間負載的挑戰性不超過極端值」。
blocks.en: Minimum-maximum bracketing: Validate the heaviest (most items) and lightest (fewest items) loads. If both extremes pass, loads in between are also accepted, provided data support that "intermediate loads are no more challenging than the extremes".

blocks.zh: 比喻：烤箱均勻受熱的擺放藝術
blocks.en: Analogy: The Art of Arranging Food in an Oven

blocks.zh: 在烤箱烤東西時，食物的擺放位置決定了是否均勻受熱——太密集空氣流通不好，某些部位可能不熟。高壓滅菌器裡的蒸氣穿透問題完全相同：物品的方向和位置決定了蒸氣是否能均勻接觸每個表面。
blocks.en: When baking in an oven, where the food is placed determines whether it heats evenly: if packed too densely, air circulates poorly and some parts may stay undercooked. The steam penetration problem in an autoclave is exactly the same: the orientation and position of items determine whether steam can contact every surface evenly.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼「裝載模式」需要確效，而不能隨意堆放——確效時的擺放方式就是生產時的標準。
blocks.en: This is why the "load pattern" must be validated rather than stacked arbitrarily: the arrangement used during validation is the production standard.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：固定裝載 vs 彈性裝載
blocks.en: Key Note: Fixed Loading vs. Flexible Loading

blocks.zh: 需要固定裝載的情況：複雜形狀、多孔材料（如摺疊布類）、有空腔的設備——蒸氣穿透對位置高度敏感。
blocks.en: When fixed loading is needed: complex shapes, porous materials (such as folded textiles), and equipment with cavities, where steam penetration is highly sensitive to position.

blocks.zh: 可用彈性裝載的情況：若能證明不同裝載量/位置對滅菌效果無實質影響（如不鏽鋼小零件裝入網籃）。
blocks.en: When flexible loading can be used: if it can be shown that different load quantities/positions have no material effect on sterilization (such as small stainless steel parts in a mesh basket).

blocks.zh: Bowie-Dick 測試：是多孔負載滅菌器的標準功能測試（EN 285 要求），用一個標準化的多孔測試包來確認空氣排除效率——不是滅菌確效，而是每日功能性確認。PDA TR1 提供了更適合製藥工業的 BI 研究方法。
blocks.en: Bowie-Dick test: the standard functional test for porous-load sterilizers (required by EN 285). A standardized porous test pack confirms air removal efficiency. It is not sterilization validation but a daily functional check. PDA TR1 provides BI study methods better suited to the pharmaceutical industry.

blocks.zh: 某廠需要在同一台滅菌器中處理三種不同尺寸的不鏽鋼容器（500 mL、1000 mL、2000 mL）。請描述如何設計一個「括弧法」確效方案，以支持這三種尺寸的混合裝載。
blocks.en: A site needs to process three sizes of stainless steel containers (500 mL, 1000 mL, 2000 mL) in the same sterilizer. Describe how to design a "bracketing" validation plan to support a mixed load of these three sizes.

blocks.zh: Bowie-Dick 測試失敗表示什麼？應採取什麼行動？這與 BI（生物指示劑）失敗的意義有何不同？
blocks.en: What does a Bowie-Dick test failure indicate? What action should be taken? How does it differ in meaning from a BI (biological indicator) failure?

blocks.zh: 比喻：安全帶 vs 安全網
blocks.en: Analogy: Seat Belt vs. Safety Net

blocks.zh: 滅菌過濾器是「安全帶」——直接保護乘客（產品）的最後防線，必須每次確認有效（完整性測試）。
blocks.en: A sterilizing filter is the "seat belt": the last line of defense that directly protects the passenger (the product), and it must be confirmed effective every time (integrity test).

blocks.zh: 生物負荷降低過濾器是「安全網」——它的破損不一定直接導致事故，因為後面還有其他控制步驟（如最終滅菌）。要不要測，看這張網在整個安全體系中的位置有多關鍵。
blocks.en: A bioburden reduction filter is the "safety net": a failure does not necessarily lead directly to an accident, because other controls follow (such as terminal sterilization). Whether to test depends on how critical this net is within the overall safety system.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：PUPSIT（使用前滅菌後完整性測試）預告
blocks.en: Key Note: A Preview of PUPSIT (Pre-Use Post-Sterilization Integrity Testing)

blocks.zh: 本 Topic 討論的是非滅菌用途的 0.2 µm 過濾器。對於滅菌過濾器（Sterilizing-grade Filter），EU Annex 1 2022 要求的 PUPSIT（Pre-Use Post-Sterilization Integrity Test，使用前滅菌後完整性測試）是更進一步的要求——詳見 PDA PtC-1 後續 Topics J/K，以及 PDA TR26 完整討論。
blocks.en: This Topic discusses 0.2 µm filters for non-sterilizing purposes. For sterilizing-grade filters, the PUPSIT (Pre-Use Post-Sterilization Integrity Test) required by EU Annex 1 2022 is a further requirement. See the later Topics J/K of PDA PtC-1 and the full discussion in PDA TR26.

blocks.zh: PUPSIT 的爭議焦點：如何在不汙染無菌批次的情況下，在滅菌後、使用前進行完整性測試？EU Annex 1 2022 Section 8.85–8.87 提出了具體要求。
blocks.en: The point of contention in PUPSIT: how to perform an integrity test after sterilization and before use without contaminating the sterile batch? EU Annex 1 2022 Sections 8.85-8.87 set out specific requirements.

blocks.zh: 某生物製劑製程中，在病毒去除過濾器（Virus Removal Filter，20nm）前有一個 0.2 µm 預過濾器用於保護病毒過濾器。根據 PtC-1 的風險評估框架，您會建議對這個 0.2 µm 預過濾器做完整性測試嗎？理由是什麼？
blocks.en: In a biologics process, a 0.2 µm prefilter sits upstream of a virus removal filter (20 nm) to protect it. Under PtC-1's risk assessment framework, would you recommend integrity testing of this 0.2 µm prefilter? What is the rationale?

blocks.zh: 某製程設計採用兩個串聯的 0.2 µm 滅菌過濾器，確效為「雙過濾器缺一不可」。若第一個過濾器（上游）通過完整性測試，第二個（下游）是否仍需測試？
blocks.en: A process design uses two 0.2 µm sterilizing filters in series, validated as "both filters are indispensable". If the first (upstream) filter passes its integrity test, does the second (downstream) still need to be tested?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：過濾器完整性測試的決策邏輯
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Decision Logic for Filter Integrity Testing

blocks.zh: 這個 Topic 的核心問題是：「不是所有 0.2 µm 過濾器都需要完整性測試。」 關鍵是它在製程中的用途與位置。
blocks.en: The core point of this Topic: "Not every 0.2 µm filter needs an integrity test." What matters is its purpose and position in the process.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：標準的法規地位層級
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Hierarchy of Regulatory Standing of Standards

blocks.zh: 這個 Topic 回答了一個實務中常見的困惑：「我必須遵守 EN 285 和 ISO 17665-1 嗎？」
blocks.en: This Topic answers a common practical question: "Must I comply with EN 285 and ISO 17665-1?"

blocks.zh: 答案：不是「強制」，而是「可用作參考」。製藥滅菌的法規要求來自 EU GMP Annex 1 和 FDA Guidance，而這兩份文件並未直接引用 EN 285 或 ISO 17665-1 作為強制要求（對比：EU Annex 1 2022 確實引用了 ISO 14644 作為潔淨室分級依據）。
blocks.en: The answer: not "mandatory", but "usable as a reference". The regulatory requirements for pharmaceutical sterilization come from EU GMP Annex 1 and FDA guidance, and neither of these documents directly cites EN 285 or ISO 17665-1 as a mandatory requirement (by contrast, EU Annex 1 2022 does cite ISO 14644 as the basis for cleanroom classification).

blocks.zh: ▼ 滅菌標準層級示意
blocks.en: ▼ Hierarchy of sterilization standards

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) — 法規強制
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) - Regulatory requirement

blocks.zh: FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004) — 強烈建議
blocks.en: FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance (2004) - Strongly recommended

blocks.zh: PDA TR1 (Revised 2007) — 最佳實務（製藥專用）
blocks.en: PDA TR1 (Revised 2007) - Best practice (pharmaceutical-specific)

blocks.zh: ISO 17665-1 / EN 285 — 參考工具（醫療器械標準）
blocks.en: ISO 17665-1 / EN 285 - Reference tools (medical device standards)

blocks.zh: 比喻：烹飪指南 vs 健康食品法規
blocks.en: Analogy: A Cookbook vs. Food Safety Law

blocks.zh: EN 285 和 ISO 17665-1 就像「米其林烹飪指南」——非常有價值，但不是「食品安全法」。您可以用它們來提升製程品質，但監管機構稽查的基準是 EU GMP Annex 1 和 FDA Guidance，而非這些標準。
blocks.en: EN 285 and ISO 17665-1 are like the "Michelin Guide": very valuable, but not "food safety law". You can use them to improve process quality, but the benchmark regulators inspect against is EU GMP Annex 1 and FDA guidance, not these standards.

blocks.zh: 相對地，ISO 14644（潔淨室標準）已被 EU Annex 1 2022 直接引用，就像「食品安全法中規定的具體操作規範」——這才算強制。
blocks.en: By contrast, ISO 14644 (the cleanroom standard) is directly cited by EU Annex 1 2022, like "the specific operating rules written into the food safety law", and that is what makes it mandatory.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：物理法 vs 生物法的爭議
blocks.en: Key Note: The Physical vs. Biological Method Debate

blocks.zh: ISO 17665-2 Annex A（物理量測法，EN 285 導向）vs Annex B（生物指示劑法，PDA TR1 導向）代表了製藥與醫療器械兩個行業的不同偏好：
blocks.en: ISO 17665-2 Annex A (physical measurement method, EN 285 oriented) vs. Annex B (biological indicator method, PDA TR1 oriented) reflect the different preferences of the pharmaceutical and medical device industries:

blocks.zh: 製藥行業：堅持使用生物指示劑（BI）確認滅菌效力——物理數據是必要條件，但不充分
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical industry: insists on biological indicators (BI) to confirm sterilization efficacy; physical data are necessary but not sufficient

blocks.zh: 醫療器械/醫院：EN 285 的物理測試（如 Bowie-Dick）通常被認為足夠
blocks.en: Medical devices/hospitals: the physical tests of EN 285 (such as Bowie-Dick) are generally considered sufficient

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-1 明確支持「大多數製藥業者不接受純物理測量，沒有 BI 數據的確認是不夠的」——這是業界共識，也是稽查員的期望。
blocks.en: PDA PtC-1 explicitly supports the view that "most pharmaceutical manufacturers do not accept purely physical measurements; confirmation without BI data is not enough". This is an industry consensus and also the inspectors' expectation.

blocks.zh: SIP 注意事項：EN 285 和 ISO 17665-1 都不直接適用於 SIP 系統——SIP 的最佳實務參考應為 ISO 13408-5 和 PDA TR61。
blocks.en: SIP considerations: Neither EN 285 nor ISO 17665-1 applies directly to SIP systems. The best-practice references for SIP should be ISO 13408-5 and PDA TR61.

blocks.zh: 稽查員問：「您的高壓滅菌確效是否符合 EN 285？」根據 PDA PtC-1，您應如何回應才能既正確又不過度承諾？
blocks.en: An auditor asks: "Is your autoclave validation compliant with EN 285?" According to PDA PtC-1, how should you respond so that you are both accurate and do not over-commit?

blocks.zh: 為什麼製藥行業對蒸氣滅菌確效要求生物指示劑（BI）數據，而不接受純物理量測？其科學邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does the pharmaceutical industry require biological indicator (BI) data for steam sterilization validation and not accept purely physical measurements? What is the scientific logic?

blocks.zh: 比喻：太空艙密封性測試
blocks.en: Analogy: Spacecraft Hull Leak Testing

blocks.zh: 凍乾機在冷凍乾燥過程中就像一個「太空艙」——產品（未封口的小瓶）完全依賴艙體的密封性來防止外界汙染空氣進入。HEPA 過濾的單向流不再保護它，因為產品在密閉腔體內。
blocks.en: During freeze-drying, a lyophilizer is like a "spacecraft": the product (unstoppered vials) depends entirely on the tightness of the chamber to keep contaminated outside air out. HEPA-filtered unidirectional flow no longer protects it, because the product is inside a closed chamber.

blocks.zh: 脫氣（Outgassing）就像艙壁上的水分蒸發——即使密封完好，壓力計也會顯示壓力上升，因為這是物理現象而非洩漏。這就是為什麼必須在相同條件下比較測試結果，而不是看絕對值。
blocks.en: Outgassing is like moisture evaporating from the hull walls: even if the seal is perfect, the pressure gauge will show a pressure rise, because this is a physical phenomenon, not a leak. This is why test results must be compared under the same conditions rather than judged by absolute values.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：EU Annex 1 2022 對凍乾機洩漏的要求
blocks.en: Key Note: EU Annex 1 2022 Requirements for Lyophilizer Leaks

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 2022 Section 9.40–9.43 對凍乾機的要求包括：
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 2022 Sections 9.40-9.43 set the following requirements for lyophilizers:

blocks.zh: 每次使用前（裝料前）必須對凍乾機進行洩漏測試
blocks.en: A leak test of the lyophilizer must be performed before each use (before loading)

blocks.zh: 洩漏測試規格應在確效過程中建立，而不是單純依賴設備廠商的規格
blocks.en: The leak test specification should be established during validation, not simply rely on the equipment manufacturer's specification

blocks.zh: 凍乾機的艙門密封、冷凝器連接等關鍵密封點必須定期檢查
blocks.en: Critical sealing points such as the chamber door seal and condenser connections must be inspected periodically

blocks.zh: CCS（污染控制策略）應涵蓋凍乾機的洩漏風險
blocks.en: The CCS (contamination control strategy) should cover the leak risk of the lyophilizer

blocks.zh: 接受標準的挑戰：PDA PtC-1 誠實指出「目前尚無強科學依據支持真空/洩漏測試的可接受值應該是多少」——接受標準的建立主要依靠設備廠商規格和廠內歷史趨勢數據。
blocks.en: The challenge of acceptance criteria: PDA PtC-1 candidly notes that "there is currently no strong scientific basis for what the acceptable value of a vacuum/leak test should be". Acceptance criteria are set mainly on the basis of manufacturer specifications and the site's historical trend data.

blocks.zh: 公式：洩漏率的表達方式
blocks.en: Formula: How Leak Rate Is Expressed

blocks.zh:
洩漏率單位（Leak Rate Units）：
─────────────────────────────────────
方式 1（絕對壓力上升率）：
  洩漏率 = ΔP / Δt
  單位：µmHg/min 或 mTorr/min

方式 2（體積標準化，適合比較不同尺寸設備）：
  洩漏率 = ΔP × V / Δt
  單位：µmHg·L/min

  其中：
  ΔP = 測試期間壓力上升值（µmHg）
  Δt = 測試時間（min）
  V  = 腔體體積（L）
─────────────────────────────────────
注意：後者更適合比較不同規格凍乾機。
脫氣干擾：蒸氣滅菌後測得值 >> 乾燥狀態真實洩漏率，
兩者不可直接比較。
blocks.en:
Leak rate units:
─────────────────────────────────────
Method 1 (absolute pressure rise rate):
  Leak rate = ΔP / Δt
  Unit: µmHg/min or mTorr/min

Method 2 (volume-normalized, suitable for comparing equipment of different sizes):
  Leak rate = ΔP × V / Δt
  Unit: µmHg·L/min

  Where:
  ΔP = pressure rise during the test (µmHg)
  Δt = test time (min)
  V  = chamber volume (L)
─────────────────────────────────────
Note: the latter is better for comparing lyophilizers of different sizes.
Outgassing interference: the value measured after steam sterilization >> the true leak rate in the dry state,
so the two cannot be compared directly.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：凍乾機洩漏程序建立建議
blocks.en: Practical Application: Recommendations for Establishing a Lyophilizer Leak Procedure

blocks.zh: CDMO 在建立凍乾機洩漏測試程序時，建議：
blocks.en: When establishing a lyophilizer leak test procedure, a CDMO is advised to:

blocks.zh: 建立雙重規格：一套用於「乾淨乾燥狀態（預防性維護用）」，一套用於「滅菌後批次前（常規 in-process）」，兩者分開記錄與趨勢追蹤
blocks.en: Establish dual specifications: one for the "clean, dry state (for preventive maintenance)" and one for "after sterilization, before the batch (routine in-process)", recorded and trended separately

blocks.zh: 條件標準化：固定測試溫度、測試時間、初始抽真空壓力——結果只在相同條件下比較才有意義
blocks.en: Standardize conditions: fix the test temperature, test time and initial pump-down pressure. Results are meaningful only when compared under identical conditions

blocks.zh: 建立趨勢基線：收集 20–30 次歷史數據，建立控制圖，設定警戒限（Alert）與行動限（Action）
blocks.en: Establish a trend baseline: collect 20-30 historical data points, build a control chart, and set alert and action limits

blocks.zh: 供應商規格作為參考下限，廠內確效數據建立上限接受標準
blocks.en: Use the supplier's specification as the lower reference, with in-house validation data establishing the upper acceptance criterion

blocks.zh: 凍乾機批次前洩漏測試的壓力上升值比上一批高出 30%，仍在接受標準內。您是否需要採取行動？如何決策？
blocks.en: The pressure rise in a lyophilizer's pre-batch leak test is 30% higher than the previous batch, but still within the acceptance criterion. Do you need to take action? How do you decide?

blocks.zh: 為什麼蒸氣滅菌後立即進行的洩漏測試結果會比乾燥狀態下高很多？主要的化學/物理原因是什麼？這對接受標準設定有什麼含義？
blocks.en: Why is the result of a leak test performed immediately after steam sterilization much higher than in the dry state? What are the main chemical/physical reasons? What does this imply for setting acceptance criteria?

blocks.zh: 某 300 L 凍乾機的洩漏率規格為「≤ 10 µmHg/min」。如果工廠新購入一台 600 L 型號，接受標準應如何調整？請用體積標準化方式計算。
blocks.en: A 300 L lyophilizer has a leak rate specification of "≤ 10 µmHg/min". If the site purchases a new 600 L model, how should the acceptance criterion be adjusted? Calculate using volume normalization.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：凍乾機洩漏測試的兩種模式
blocks.en: Key Concept: Two Modes of Lyophilizer Leak Testing

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-1 特別強調必須區分兩種測試，因為它們的目的和條件完全不同：
blocks.en: PDA PtC-1 specifically stresses distinguishing between two tests, because their purposes and conditions are entirely different:

blocks.zh: 關鍵結論：批次前測試不等於真實洩漏率——但它是每批次產品保護的重要控制點。
blocks.en: Key conclusion: the pre-batch test is not the true leak rate, but it is an important control point for protecting each batch of product.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: V-A 物料進場：最佳方式為單向滅菌通道（雙門高壓滅菌釜/去熱原隧道）；多層包裝脫層法是次佳選項；RTP 適用於隔離器/RABS；進場物料必須在核准清單上，否則走偏差程序
blocks.en: V-A Material entry: The best approach is a unidirectional sterilization process (double-door autoclave/depyrogenation tunnel); sequential wrapper removal is the second-best option; RTP suits isolators/RABS; materials entering must be on the approved list, otherwise the deviation procedure applies

blocks.zh: V-B 無菌保存期：決定因素是「屏障完整性」，不是時間；滅菌後在 Grade A/B 中可無限期保持無菌；必須設置最大期限並在 APS 中確效；RTP 罐通氣過濾器需做使用後完整性測試
blocks.en: V-B Sterile hold time: The determining factor is barrier integrity, not time; after sterilization, materials can remain sterile indefinitely in Grade A/B; a maximum period must be set and validated in an APS; RTP canister vent filters need a post-use integrity test

blocks.zh: VI-A 消毒程序：不強制輪替，但應使用多種消毒劑包括定期殺孢子劑；計畫應由 EM 數據驅動；隔離器必須用氣態/霧化殺孢子劑；EU Annex 1 2022 強制 Grade A/B 使用無菌消毒劑
blocks.en: VI-A Disinfection program: Rotation is not mandatory, but several disinfectants, including a periodic sporicide, should be used; the program should be driven by EM data; isolators must use a gaseous/aerosolized sporicide; EU Annex 1 2022 mandates sterile disinfectants in Grade A/B

blocks.zh: VI-B 滅菌消毒劑：Grade A/B 使用的消毒劑本身必須無菌；自製稀釋液需 0.2 µm 過濾並確效保存期；購買成品無需另做無菌測試（供應商稽核＋CoA 即可）；殺孢子劑因具自我滅菌特性可例外
blocks.en: VI-B Sterile disinfectants: Disinfectants used in Grade A/B must themselves be sterile; in-house dilutions need 0.2 µm filtration and a validated hold time; purchased finished product needs no separate sterility test (supplier audit + CoA is sufficient); sporicides may be an exception because of their self-sterilizing properties

blocks.zh: VI-C 包裝件保存期：優先選用熱封預製袋（可量化確效）；最大期限基於屏障特性、操作程序、儲存環境；Media Fill 是補充依據，非主要確效工具；確效後無需定期重新確效（除非有變更）
blocks.en: VI-C Packaged-item hold time: Prefer heat-sealed pre-formed pouches (quantitatively validatable); the maximum period is based on barrier properties, operating procedures and storage environment; media fill is supporting evidence, not the primary validation tool; no periodic revalidation after validation (unless there is a change)

blocks.zh: VI-D 重新確效頻率：建議每 12 個月定期重新確效；任何設備/製程變更須評估後重新確效；多台等效滅菌器可減少工作量；重新確效應包含維護/校正數據回顧和變更控制文件審查
blocks.en: VI-D Requalification frequency: Periodic requalification every 12 months is recommended; any equipment/process change must be assessed and requalified; several equivalent sterilizers can reduce the workload; requalification should include review of maintenance/calibration data and change control documents

blocks.zh: VI-E 多孔/硬質物品確效：裝載模式必須確效；可用最小-最大括弧法；關鍵是確保空氣排除、蒸氣穿透、冷凝液排除；Bowie-Dick 是日常功能確認，BI 是確效核心
blocks.en: VI-E Porous/hard goods validation: The load pattern must be validated; minimum-maximum bracketing may be used; the key is to ensure air removal, steam penetration and condensate removal; Bowie-Dick is a routine functional check, BI is the core of validation

blocks.zh: VI-F 0.2µm 過濾器完整性測試：非滅菌用途的 0.2µm 過濾器是否測試，由風險評估決定；備援滅菌過濾器：若主過濾器通過則不需測；若確效為雙過濾器缺一不可，則兩者都必須測
blocks.en: VI-F 0.2 µm filter integrity testing: Whether a non-sterilizing 0.2 µm filter is tested is decided by risk assessment; redundant sterilizing filters: if the primary filter passes, no test is needed; if validated as both filters indispensable, both must be tested

blocks.zh: VI-G 蒸氣滅菌器標準：EN 285 和 ISO 17665-1 對製藥業是「參考工具」，非強制要求；製藥確效必須包含 BI 數據，不接受純物理測量；SIP 不適用 EN 285 和 ISO 17665-1；首選 PDA TR1 作為製藥蒸氣滅菌確效指南
blocks.en: VI-G Steam sterilizer standards: EN 285 and ISO 17665-1 are "reference tools" for the pharmaceutical industry, not mandatory requirements; pharmaceutical validation must include BI data and purely physical measurements are not accepted; EN 285 and ISO 17665-1 do not apply to SIP; PDA TR1 is the preferred guide for pharmaceutical steam sterilization validation

blocks.zh: VI-H 凍乾機洩漏確效：每批次滅菌後、裝料前必須測試；批次前測試不等於真實洩漏率（受 Outgassing 影響）；接受標準依廠內趨勢建立，非單純依賴廠商規格；EU Annex 1 2022 Section 9.40–9.43 有明確要求
blocks.en: VI-H Lyophilizer leak qualification: A test must be performed after each sterilization and before loading; the pre-batch test is not the true leak rate (affected by outgassing); acceptance criteria are set from in-house trends, not simply from manufacturer specifications; EU Annex 1 2022 Sections 9.40-9.43 contain explicit requirements
